detail: BETBOOM have won three straight series (PARIVISION 2-1, Legacy 2-1, Falcons 2-1) and the market re-rated them from roughly 21% (17 Oct labelled fallback) to 28.7-28.9% (01:00Z reads). Recorded so the reasoning is reviewable, not as a hidden recommendation. See data/research/039c5a22/contrarian-review.json.

title: kyxsan faces his former team Falcons in the third-place match - verified history, unverified effect
detail: HLTV's 8 July 2026 rebuild report (verified re-read 01:03Z) records that Aurora IGL kyxsan led Falcons from January 2025 until he was benched for karrigan in April 2026. This is a plausible motivation storyline for the 11:30 UTC decider and nothing more: no roster, revenge, rest or onboarding premium is applied to any price. The same report dates the whole rebuild (kyxsan, Jimpphat, coach ash) to July, not tournament week, so it cannot support a last-minute onboarding discount either.

title: Text extraction of the live pages shows the stale-warning banner even on a fresh snapshot - likely a hidden-node artifact
detail: The live data/latest.json at 00:42:48Z is fresh (inventory_observed_at 00:42:36Z, inventory_crosscheck complete), yet markdown extraction of every page includes the 'Do not treat these as current picks' banner text. Repository notes record that extraction includes hidden nodes and that browser visibility is covered by the Playwright suite; a real-browser/phone check was not repeated in this session. If a human ever sees this banner on a fresh snapshot in a phone browser, that would be a real presentation defect worth escalating - current evidence points to an extraction artifact only.

title: Correction applied to a published flag: Day-1 9z-Aurora map scores were misattributed
detail: Line-by-line verification found that flag 9866e1ba-aurora-july-rebuild-no-double-discount printed the Day-1 upset maps as 'Mirage 10-13, Dust2 11-13'. The official HLTV match page 2399384 (re-read 2026-10-18T00:58Z) shows the played maps were Inferno 13-11 (8:4; 5:7) and Nuke 13-1 (11:1; 2:0), with Mirage banned in the veto, and the site's own edge review already publishes 'Inferno 13-11 · Nuke 13-1'. The misattributed pair is consistent with the 3 October ESL Pro League 24 meeting instead. The parenthetical in the flag was corrected to the official values (Inferno 11-13, Nuke 1-13 from Aurora's perspective) with the rest of the finding preserved; the correction is logged on the board. No probability or pick changes.
